caption: Ireland v. Hegseth
citation_line: Ireland v. Hegseth, No. 1:25-cv-01918, ECF No. 28 (D.N.J. Mar. 24, 2025)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge O'Hearn entered a fourteen-day temporary restraining order preventing the Air Force from initiating involuntary separation proceedings against two transgender service members under Executive Order 14183 and its implementing guidance.
qualification_rationale: The ruling addressed equal protection, military deference, exhaustion, and irreparable injury in a nationally covered challenge to the 2025 transgender-service policy. It treated sex-based classifications as subject to intermediate scrutiny and found the plaintiffs likely to succeed.
appellate_posture_note: No Third Circuit merits disposition was identified. The order was emergency, plaintiff-specific relief and should not be described as a final merits judgment.
